description: This Java class defines an Android activity named JobsActivityExtended, responsible for displaying detailed information about a specific job. It retrieves job data from a JSON stored in local storage, parses various fields like status, customer info, pickup, and dropoff details, and populates corresponding UI elements. It also handles a button click to navigate to a signature screen.

classes.name: JobsActivityExtended
classes.description: An Android activity class that displays detailed job information by parsing JSON data and populates various UI elements. Handles user interaction to move to a signature activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets UI layout, loads job data based on intent extras, and sets up a button click listener to navigate to the signature screen.

methods.name: loadPageData
methods.description: Loads job data from local storage, parses JSON, and updates UI elements with job, customer, pickup, and drop-off details.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Cleans string inputs by replacing null, empty, or 'null' strings with an empty string.

methods.name: cleanAddress
methods.description: Appends a comma to non-null address strings for formatting.
